倍率是「(格數 ÷ 安全格數) 的層數次方 × 0.97」，所以不論難度和在第幾: The multiplier is (cell count ÷ safe cells) raised to the floor number, then multiplied by 0.97, giving an expected return of about 97% regardless of difficulty or collection floor. Urchins are placed using browser randomness when you start. Points are shared with other games and have no cash value.
倍率是「0.97 ÷ 過關率的道數次方」，所以不論難度和在第幾道領回，長期期望回: The multiplier is 0.97 divided by the crossing chance raised to the number of crossings, giving an expected return of about 97% regardless of difficulty or when you collect. The browser determines the current location when you start; a dashed line marks it afterward. Points are shared with other games and have no cash value.

完全免費、不限次數，另依平台規則累積遊玩點數；分數只用來和自己的最佳紀錄比較，最: Completely free and unlimited: no points are charged or awarded. BONUS 是固定獎勵：每走完一段 20 步立刻入帳 1 點，一趟最多 3 點，: BONUS is a fixed reward: finishing each 20-step segment pays 1 point immediately, up to 3 points per trip, once per segment. The left lane is the supply station: falling supply crates carry shields, and breaking them upgrades your gear (Ballpoint Pen, Stapler, Shredder, Laser Pointer, Coffee Rocket, Printer, Seen-Zone Cannon) or gives boosts such as fire rate, damage or an extra hand. You fire automatically; just move left and right and choose between the lanes.

Points already credited are never taken back if you lose later.

A campfire appears at level 5 of every ten (every 20% in free run), where you pick one of three things and rest a moment. Three levels without a drop guarantees one in the next. 遊戲共 100 關、分五個世界（森林、墓地、沼澤、雪原、火山），每個世界 20: There are 100 levels in five worlds (forest, graveyard, swamp, snowfield, volcano), 20 levels per world. Every level has its own type and weather (day, dusk, night, rain, fog, snow, ash, heat and so on; never the same twice in a row). New ghosts appear on levels 4, 8, 12 and 16, and level 10 is the boss. Some levels have a chest, a traveler or the little critter Nib. You have 3 lives (max 5); if you die you retry the same level, and when you run out you start over from level 1 with no checkpoint. Beating a boss adds a life, and resting at a campfire can restore one life (at most once per ten levels). After two deaths on the same level, Flick gives you 0.3 s more warning and one attack fewer (the screen tells you). Level 1 and boss levels use a fixed seed, other levels are random; enter a seed code to replay the same round, or pick the daily challenge (same level and seed for everyone that day; no life lost, no save, no points, just a score to compare). You can only choose up to the level you actually reached this run; once your lives run out you the whole run restarts and you cannot jump back. Every level sends all its attacks before the door opens. Level 0 is a free run with no lives; in the codex you can listen to the clues and practice a ghost, with no lives lost and no points paid.

每隻鬼都有自己的線索和答案。葉下客（第 4 關）：腳邊的落葉聚成一堆，睜開紅眼，: Every ghost has its own clue and answer. Leafling (level 4): the leaves pile up at your feet and a red eye opens; hide on the other side and hold on for 3 seconds. Knocker (level 8): the birds fly off, then knocking comes from one side; hide on the side opposite the knocking; later levels come back for two passes. Hush (level 12): the crickets stop and a prop appears on each side; it fears the lantern, so tap the lantern's side. Tapping the wrong one kills you. Gale (level 16): the wind reverses and leaves turn against it, then dragging approaches from one side; hide on the side the wind comes from. Reacher (level 22): the soil bulges and mud bubbles; hide on the other side and hold on for 2 seconds. Bellkeeper (level 23): the bell tolls three times; after the third, swipe down to lower your head and keep it down until the toll fades. Before each boss level you meet the ghosts you have learned in turn, and the last is the Hollow: it fears the talisman. Glassface (the level 30 boss) fears the hammer, and the Ash Flock fears the bucket. From level 15 on there may be false omens (just a scare), and from level 25 attacks can come back to back.

你是一顆往前滑行的小機器人，前面不斷出現有缺口的牆，缺口高度對應 C D E F: You are a little robot gliding forward while walls with a gap keep arriving. The height of the gap matches one of seven notes, C D E F G A B (octave 4). Sing that note into the microphone, keep your pitch within the tolerance and hold it for 0.2–0.25 seconds to slip through. If you have not hit the note by the time the wall passes, you lose one of your 3 hearts. A pass is graded Perfect, Good or OK by how close you were, and passes in a row build your combo score.
共 5 個世界、每個 4 關，外加無盡模式：世界 1 全提示（缺口高度、音名、顏: There are 5 worlds of 4 levels each, plus an endless mode. World 1 gives every cue (gap height, note name, color and a reference tone); World 2 has you sing public-domain tunes such as Twinkle Twinkle; World 3 hides the gap height; World 4 leaves only a color flash; World 5 removes cues step by step so you rely on memory and absolute pitch. Later worlds allow less error (±45 down to ±30 cents). By default “Any octave” only checks the note name, so a higher or lower octave counts; you can switch to strict octave 4.

集滿 5 本同色書！自動升起擋板、貼上膠帶並蓋章封箱！: Five of a kind! The front panel rises, tape goes on, and the box is stamped shut!
點一個箱子拿起頂部同色書，再點另一個箱子疊放。: Tap a box to lift its top books, then tap another box to place them.

全部 30 關逐關通關解鎖。後面的關卡敵群更多、更硬，後段連一般敵人也會游得更快: All 30 stages unlock one by one. Later stages bring bigger, tougher swarms, and in the late stages even ordinary enemies swim faster, while energy income rises only slightly.
